verdict.rationale: Prefix caching is a fair performance axis for a local LLM inference runtime like Ollama, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions prefix caching, KV-cache reuse, or speeding up repeated prompts. The concurrency, throughput and benchmark items are about different capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
